title: Add a token bucket rate limiter to the login route
context: Service exposes POST /login. We are adding a per-IP rate limiter to slow credential-stuffing. Node/Express. The limiter is an in-memory Map keyed by IP. Reviewers should assume a single process for now; a Redis-backed version is a later change.
notes_for_reviewer: The buckets Map is never pruned. Consider whether entries accumulate for every distinct IP.
x-forwarded-for can be a comma-separated list when there are multiple proxies.
No test file is included in this change.
